# vendor

Two small libraries that every archive page carries inside itself, so a page never fetches anything
from the internet. Each file is unchanged from its official release and keeps its own license header.

| File | Library | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `marked.min.js` | marked: turns Markdown into HTML | 12.0.2 | MIT | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/marked/12.0.2/marked.min.js |
| `purify.min.js` | DOMPurify: cleans HTML before it is shown | 3.1.6 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dompurify/3.1.6/purify.min.js |

To update one, replace the file with the new official release and change this table.
